+defmodule Sigra.Test.CITimingFormatter do
+  @moduledoc false
+
+  use GenServer
+
+  @unit "microsecond"
+  @count_keys [:passed, :failed, :skipped, :excluded]
+
+  @doc false
+  def new_state(path, invocation \\ System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION")) do
+    %{
+      path: path,
+      invocation: invocation,
+      tests: [],
+      counts: Map.new(@count_keys, &{&1, 0}),
+      test_duration_sum_us: 0,
+      diagnostics: [],
+      started_at_us: nil,
+      aborted?: false
+    }
+  end
+
+  @impl true
+  def init(_opts) do
+    path = System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON")
+    state = new_state(path, System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION"))
+
+    case clear_previous_report(path) do
+      :ok ->
+        {:ok, state}
+
+      {:error, reason} ->
+        report_write_error(reason)
+        {:ok, add_diagnostic(state, "previous_output_unavailable")}
+    end
+  end
+
+  @impl true
+  def handle_cast({:suite_started, _opts}, state) do
+    {:noreply, %{state | started_at_us: System.monotonic_time(:microsecond)}}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:test_finished, %ExUnit.Test{} = test}, state) do
+    id = test_id(test)
+    result = result(test.state)
+    state = update_in(state.counts[result], &(&1 + 1))
+
+    if result == :excluded do
+      {:noreply, state}
+    else
+      case test.time do
+        time when is_integer(time) and time >= 0 ->
+          row = %{
+            invocation: state.invocation,
+            test_id: id,
+            module: inspect(test.module),
+            name: Atom.to_string(test.name),
+            result: Atom.to_string(result),
+            duration_us: time,
+            unit: @unit
+          }
+
+          state =
+            state
+            |> update_in([:tests], &[row | &1])
+            |> update_in([:test_duration_sum_us], &(&1 + time))
+
+          {:noreply, state}
+
+        _ ->
+          {:noreply, add_diagnostic(state, "test_duration_unavailable:#{id}")}
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:max_failures_reached, _}, state) do
+    {:noreply, state |> Map.put(:aborted?, true) |> add_diagnostic("max_failures_reached")}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast(:max_failures_reached, state) do
+    {:noreply, state |> Map.put(:aborted?, true) |> add_diagnostic("max_failures_reached")}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:suite_finished, times_us}, state) do
+    report = build_report(state, times_us, true)
+    write_report(state.path, report)
+    {:noreply, state}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:sigquit, _current}, state) do
+    state = state |> Map.put(:aborted?, true) |> add_diagnostic("suite_interrupted")
+    write_report(state.path, build_report(state, %{}, false))
+    {:noreply, state}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast(_event, state), do: {:noreply, state}
+
+  defp build_report(state, times_us, suite_finished?) do
+    {run_us, diagnostics} = measured_time(times_us, :run, state.diagnostics)
+    {async_us, diagnostics} = measured_time(times_us, :async, diagnostics, optional: true)
+    {load_us, diagnostics} = measured_time(times_us, :load, diagnostics, optional: true)
+
+    suite_elapsed_us =
+      case {state.started_at_us, suite_finished?} do
+        {started_at_us, true} when is_integer(started_at_us) ->
+          max(System.monotonic_time(:microsecond) - started_at_us, 0)
+
+        _ ->
+          nil
+      end
+
+    diagnostics =
+      if is_nil(suite_elapsed_us) and suite_finished? do
+        ["suite_elapsed_unavailable" | diagnostics]
+      else
+        diagnostics
+      end
+
+    %{
+      unit: @unit,
+      invocation: state.invocation,
+      tests: Enum.reverse(state.tests),
+      counts: Map.new(state.counts, fn {key, value} -> {Atom.to_string(key), value} end),
+      passed_count: state.counts.passed,
+      failed_count: state.counts.failed,
+      skipped_count: state.counts.skipped,
+      excluded_count: state.counts.excluded,
+      suite_elapsed_us: suite_elapsed_us,
+      run_us: run_us,
+      async_us: async_us,
+      load_us: load_us,
+      test_duration_sum_us: state.test_duration_sum_us,
+      complete: suite_finished? and not state.aborted? and diagnostics == [],
+      diagnostics: Enum.reverse(diagnostics)
+    }
+  end
+
+  defp measured_time(times_us, key, diagnostics, opts \\ []) do
+    case {Map.get(times_us, key), opts[:optional]} do
+      {value, _optional} when is_integer(value) and value >= 0 ->
+        {value, diagnostics}
+
+      {nil, true} ->
+        {nil, diagnostics}
+
+      _ ->
+        {nil, ["#{key}_time_unavailable" | diagnostics]}
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp result(nil), do: :passed
+  defp result({:failed, _}), do: :failed
+  defp result({:invalid, _}), do: :failed
+  defp result({:skipped, _}), do: :skipped
+  defp result({:excluded, _}), do: :excluded
+  defp result(_), do: :failed
+
+  defp test_id(%ExUnit.Test{module: module, name: name}),
+    do: "#{inspect(module)}.#{Atom.to_string(name)}"
+
+  defp add_diagnostic(state, diagnostic),
+    do: update_in(state.diagnostics, &[diagnostic | &1])
+
+  defp clear_previous_report(path) when is_binary(path) and path != "" do
+    case File.rm(path) do
+      :ok -> :ok
+      {:error, :enoent} -> :ok
+      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp clear_previous_report(_path), do: :ok
+
+  defp write_report(path, report) when is_binary(path) and path != "" do
+    temporary_path = path <> ".tmp." <> Integer.to_string(System.unique_integer([:positive]))
+    contents = Jason.encode!(report)
+
+    case File.write(temporary_path, contents, [:binary, :exclusive]) do
+      :ok ->
+        case File.rename(temporary_path, path) do
+          :ok ->
+            :ok
+
+          {:error, reason} ->
+            File.rm(temporary_path)
+            report_write_error(reason)
+        end
+
+      {:error, reason} ->
+        report_write_error(reason)
+    end
+  rescue
+    _ -> report_write_error(:encoding_failed)
+  end
+
+  defp write_report(_path, _report), do: report_write_error(:output_path_missing)
+
+  defp report_write_error(reason) do
+    diagnostic =
+      if reason == :output_path_missing, do: "output_path_missing", else: "write_failed"
+
+    message =
+      Jason.encode!(%{
+        complete: false,
+        diagnostic: diagnostic,
+        reason: reason |> :file.format_error() |> List.to_string()
+      })
+
+    IO.puts(:stderr, "SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON: #{message}")
+
+    :error
+  end
+end",

              "deletions": 0,
              "filename": "scripts/ci/ci-exunit-timing.test.sh",
              "patch": "@@ -0,0 +1,307 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+cd "$ROOT"
+
+OUTPUT_PATH=""
+if [[ "${1:-}" == "--output" && -n "${2:-}" ]]; then
+  OUTPUT_PATH=$2
+  shift 2
+fi
+
+if [[ $# -ne 0 ]]; then
+  echo "usage: bash scripts/ci/ci-exunit-timing.test.sh [--output PATH]" >&2
+  exit 2
+fi
+
+for tool in mix node jq; do
+  if ! command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: required tool is missing: $tool" >&2
+    exit 2
+  fi
+done
+
+TMP_ROOT="$(mktemp -d)"
+cleanup() {
+  rm -rf "$TMP_ROOT"
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT
+
+export MIX_ENV=test
+export PGUSER="${PGUSER:-postgres}"
+export PGPASSWORD="${PGPASSWORD:-postgres}"
+export PGHOST="${PGHOST:-localhost}"
+
+if command -v pg_isready >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "${PGPORT:-5432}" -U "$PGUSER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+  echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: PostgreSQL is not accepting connections at $PGHOST:${PGPORT:-5432}" >&2
+  exit 2
+fi
+
+FOCUS_TEST="test/sigra/planning/ci_timing_formatter_test.exs"
+TIMED_MIX_JS='const { spawnSync } = require("node:child_process");
+const started = process.hrtime.bigint();
+const result = spawnSync("mix", ["test", "test/sigra/planning/ci_timing_formatter_test.exs"], { encoding: "utf8" });
+const elapsedUs = Number((process.hrtime.bigint() - started) / 1000n);
+if (result.stdout) process.stdout.write(result.stdout);
+if (result.stderr) process.stderr.write(result.stderr);
+if (result.error) process.stderr.write(`ci-exunit-timing.test: ${result.error.message}\n`);
+process.stderr.write(`SIGRA_TIMING_ELAPSED_US=${elapsedUs}\n`);
+process.exit(result.status === null ? 1 : result.status);'
+
+PROBE_CODE='unless Code.ensure_loaded?(Sigra.Test.CITimingFormatter) do
+  Code.require_file("test/support/ci_timing_formatter.ex")
+end
+
+formatters =
+  if System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON") in [nil, ""] do
+    [ExUnit.CLIFormatter]
+  else
+    [ExUnit.CLIFormatter, Sigra.Test.CITimingFormatter]
+  end
+
+ExUnit.start(formatters: formatters)
+
+defmodule Sigra.CITimingProcessProbe do
+  use ExUnit.Case
+
+  test "probe keeps the original ExUnit result" do
+    if System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_FAIL") == "1" do
+      assert 2 == 1
+    else
+      assert 1 == 1
+    end
+  end
+end'
+
+run_probe() {
+  local log_path=$1
+  shift
+  local status
+
+  if "$@" >"$log_path" 2>&1; then
+    status=0
+  else
+    status=$?
+  fi
+
+  printf '%s\n' "$status"
+}
+
+has_write_diagnostic() {
+  local log_path=$1
+  local diagnostic
+
+  diagnostic="$(sed -n 's/^SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON: //p' "$log_path" | tail -n 1)"
+  [[ -n "$diagnostic" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$diagnostic" | jq -e '.complete == false and .diagnostic == "write_failed" and (.reason | type == "string")' >/dev/null
+}
+
+run_focus_sample() {
+  local mode=$1
+  local sample=$2
+  local log_path=$3
+  local output_path=$4
+  local status elapsed_us
+  local -a command
+
+  if [[ "$mode" == "with" ]]; then
+    command=(env "SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON=$output_path" SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION=instrumentation_test node -e "$TIMED_MIX_JS")
+  else
+    command=(env -u SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON node -e "$TIMED_MIX_JS")
+  fi
+
+  if "${command[@]}" >"$log_path" 2>&1; then
+    status=0
+  else
+    status=$?
+  fi
+
+  if [[ "$status" -ne 0 ]]; then
+    cat "$log_path" >&2
+    echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: focused suite failed in $mode sample $sample (exit $status)" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+
+  elapsed_us="$(sed -n 's/^SIGRA_TIMING_ELAPSED_US=//p' "$log_path" | tail -n 1)"
+  if [[ ! "$elapsed_us" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    cat "$log_path" >&2
+    echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: missing elapsed microseconds for $mode sample $sample" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+
+  if [[ "$mode" == "with" ]]; then
+    if [[ ! -s "$output_path" ]] || ! jq -e '.complete == true and .unit == "microsecond" and .invocation == "instrumentation_test" and (.tests | length == 3) and all(.tests[]; .invocation == "instrumentation_test")' "$output_path" >/dev/null; then
+      cat "$log_path" >&2
+      echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: instrumented sample $sample did not produce a complete three-test report" >&2
+      return 1
+    fi
+  else
+    if [[ -e "$output_path" ]] || rg -q 'SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON:' "$log_path"; then
+      cat "$log_path" >&2
+      echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: uninstrumented sample $sample produced timing output" >&2
+      return 1
+    fi
+  fi
+
+  if ! rg -q '3 tests, 0 failures' "$log_path"; then
+    cat "$log_path" >&2
+    echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: focused suite $mode sample $sample did not preserve normal ExUnit output" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+
+  printf '%s\n' "$elapsed_us"
+}
+
+PASS_PATH="$TMP_ROOT/pass.json"
+PASS_LOG="$TMP_ROOT/pass.log"
+printf '%s\n' '{"complete":true,"unit":"microsecond","tests":[]}' > "$PASS_PATH"
+PASS_STATUS="$(run_probe "$PASS_LOG" env \
+  "SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON=$PASS_PATH" \
+  "MIX_ENV=$MIX_ENV" "PGUSER=$PGUSER" "PGPASSWORD=$PGPASSWORD" "PGHOST=$PGHOST" \
+  mix run --no-start -e "$PROBE_CODE")"
+
+if [[ "$PASS_STATUS" -ne 0 ]] || ! jq -e '.complete == true and .passed_count == 1 and .failed_count == 0 and (.tests | length == 1) and .tests[0].test_id == "Sigra.CITimingProcessProbe.test probe keeps the original ExUnit result" and .tests[0].result == "passed" and (.tests[0].duration_us >= 0)' "$PASS_PATH" >/dev/null; then
+  cat "$PASS_LOG" >&2
+  echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: passing ExUnit process did not produce one complete timing row" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+rg -q 'Running ExUnit with seed:' "$PASS_LOG"
+rg -q '1 test, 0 failures' "$PASS_LOG"
+
+NO_OPT_IN_PATH="$TMP_ROOT/no-opt-in.json"
+NO_OPT_IN_LOG="$TMP_ROOT/no-opt-in.log"
+NO_OPT_IN_STATUS="$(run_probe "$NO_OPT_IN_LOG" env -u SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON \
+  "MIX_ENV=$MIX_ENV" "PGUSER=$PGUSER" "PGPASSWORD=$PGPASSWORD" "PGHOST=$PGHOST" \
+  mix run --no-start -e "$PROBE_CODE")"
+

+import test from 'node:test';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { readRepoFile, jobBlock, stripYamlComments } from './prohibitions/_lib.mjs';
+
+const workflow = stripYamlComments(readRepoFile('.github/workflows/ci.yml'));
+const playwrightConfig = readRepoFile('test/example/priv/playwright/playwright.config.ts');
+const ids = [
+  'library_tests_shard',
+  'example_unit_smoke',
+  'install_smoke',
+  'example_http_smoke',
+  'example_playwright_shard',
+];
+const blocks = Object.fromEntries(ids.map((id) => [id, jobBlock(workflow, id)]));
+
+test('keeps one library mix ci owner and preserves required check names', () => {
+  const owners = Object.entries(blocks).filter(([, block]) => /^\s+run: (?:MIX_ENV=test )?mix ci\s*$/m.test(block));
+  assert.deepEqual(owners.map(([id]) => id), ['library_tests_shard']);
+  assert.match(workflow, /^    name: Library tests\s+#?\s*$/m);
+  for (const name of [
+    'Library tests',
+    'Example unit smoke (ExUnit + ConnTest)',
+    'Install smoke (fresh phx.new + sigra.install)',
+    'Example HTTP smoke (boot + curl critical routes)',
+  ]) assert.ok(workflow.includes(name), `missing required check name ${name}`);
+  assert.ok(workflow.includes('Example Playwright shard (${{ matrix.seam }})'));
+});
+
+test('records seven distinct Playwright reports without changing the five seam selections', () => {
+  const invocations = [
+    ['admin-behavior.json', 'tests/admin-user-operations.spec.ts', 'matrix.seam == \'admin_behavior\''],
+    ['admin-checkpoints.json', 'tests/admin-checkpoints.spec.ts', 'matrix.seam == \'admin_checkpoints\''],
+    ['design-gallery-pr-behavior.json', "--grep-invert '@snapshot'", "github.event_name == 'pull_request'"],
+    ['design-gallery-nonpr-snapshots.json', "--grep '@snapshot'", "github.event_name != 'pull_request'"],
+    ['design-gallery-nonpr-behavior.json', "--grep-invert '@snapshot'", "github.event_name != 'pull_request'"],
+    ['non-admin-smoke.json', 'tests/golden-path.spec.ts', 'matrix.seam == \'non_admin_smoke\''],
+    ['demo-showcase.json', 'tests/demo-showcase.spec.ts', 'matrix.seam == \'demo_showcase\''],
+  ];
+  const paths = [];
+  for (const [path, selection, condition] of invocations) {
+    const at = workflow.indexOf(path);
+    assert.notEqual(at, -1, `missing report destination ${path}`);
+    paths.push(path);
+    const around = workflow.slice(Math.max(0, at - 1800), at + 3500);
+    assert.ok(around.includes('SIGRA_PLAYWRIGHT_JSON'), `${path} is not wired to the opt-in reporter`);
+    assert.ok(around.includes(selection), `${path} lost its selected test path/grep`);
+    assert.ok(around.includes(condition), `${path} lost its event/seam guard`);
+    assert.match(around, /--retries=0/);
+  }
+  assert.equal(new Set(paths).size, 7, 'report destinations must be unique per command');
+  for (const seam of ['admin_behavior', 'admin_checkpoints', 'design_gallery', 'non_admin_smoke', 'demo_showcase']) {
+    assert.ok(blocks.example_playwright_shard.includes(`- seam: ${seam}`), `missing matrix seam ${seam}`);
+  }
+  assert.match(playwrightConfig, /workers:\s*1/);
+  assert.match(playwrightConfig, /retries:\s*0/);
+});
+
+test('uploads separate main and dependency-off timing reports from their producing job', () => {
+  assert.match(blocks.library_tests_shard, /SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON: test-results\/ci-exunit-timing-main\.json/);
+  assert.match(blocks.library_tests_shard, /SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION: main/);
+  assert.match(blocks.library_tests_shard, /SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_THREADLINE_GUARD_JSON: test-results\/ci-exunit-timing-threadline-guard\.json/);
+  assert.match(blocks.library_tests_shard, /run: (?:MIX_ENV=test )?mix ci/);
+  const prepareTimingDirectory = blocks.library_tests_shard.indexOf('mkdir -p test-results');
+  const contributorCi = blocks.library_tests_shard.indexOf('run: mix ci');
+  assert.notEqual(prepareTimingDirectory, -1, 'library timing directory is not created');
+  assert.ok(prepareTimingDirectory < contributorCi, 'timing directory must exist before mix ci writes ExUnit timing');
+  assert.match(blocks.library_tests_shard, /if: always\(\)[\s\S]*?ci-exunit-timing-main\.json[\s\S]*?ci-exunit-timing-threadline-guard\.json/);
+  assert.match(blocks.library_tests_shard, /invocation: 'main'[\s\S]*?invocation: 'threadline_guard'/);
+  assert.match(blocks.library_tests_shard, /timing_artifact_name: `library-test-timing-\$\{process\.env\.GITHUB_RUN_ID\}-\$\{process\.env\.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT\}`/);
+  for (const [id, block] of Object.entries(blocks)) {
+    assert.match(block, /ci-measurement-metadata\.json/, `${id} lacks metadata artifact`);
+    assert.match(block, /if: always\(\)[\s\S]*?upload-artifact/, `${id} does not retain artifacts on failure`);
+    for (const key of [
+      'repository', 'run_id', 'run_attempt', 'source_sha', 'event', 'job_name', 'matrix_seam',
+      'runner_os', 'runner_arch', 'runner_image', 'configured_versions', 'observed_versions',
+      'version_unavailable',
+    ]) assert.ok(block.includes(key), `${id} metadata omits ${key}`);
+  }
+});
+
+test('metadata keeps configured pins separate from command-observed versions and cache results', () => {
+  for (const [id, block] of Object.entries(blocks)) {
+    assert.ok(block.includes('configured_versions'), `${id} missing configured pins`);
+    assert.ok(block.includes('observed_versions'), `${id} missing actual version commands`);
+    assert.ok(block.includes('version_unavailable'), `${id} must explain unavailable commands`);
+    assert.ok(block.includes('ImageOS') && block.includes('ImageVersion'), `${id} missing runner image values`);
+  }
+  for (const [id, cache] of [
+    ['library_tests_shard', 'deps_cache'],
+    ['example_unit_smoke', 'example_unit_deps_cache'],
+    ['install_smoke', 'install_smoke_deps_cache'],
+    ['example_http_smoke', 'http_smoke_deps_cache'],
+  ]) assert.ok(blocks[id].includes(`steps.${cache}.outputs.cache-hit`), `${id} cache output is not retained`);
+  assert.ok(blocks.example_playwright_shard.includes('steps.boot.outputs.deps_cache_hit'));
+  assert.ok(blocks.example_playwright_shard.includes('steps.boot.outputs.browser_cache_hit'));
+  assert.match(blocks.example_playwright_shard, /node_modules\/\.bin\/playwright/);
+  assert.match(blocks.example_playwright_shard, /capture\('elixir',\['--version'\]/);
+  assert.match(blocks.example_playwright_shard, /capture\('node',\['--version'\]/);
+});",

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+
+import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
+import { open, readFile, rename, unlink } from 'node:fs/promises';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
+
+const RESULT_STATUSES = new Set(['passed', 'failed', 'timedOut', 'skipped', 'interrupted']);
+const TEST_SUMMARY_STATUSES = new Set(['skipped', 'expected', 'unexpected', 'flaky']);
+const EXPECTED_STATUSES = RESULT_STATUSES;
+
+function isRecord(value) {
+  return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
+}
+
+function nonEmptyString(value) {
+  return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0;
+}
+
+function validDate(value) {
+  return typeof value === 'string' && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value));
+}
+
+function safePath(value) {
+  return value.replaceAll('\\', '/');
+}
+
+function compareText(left, right) {
+  return left < right ? -1 : left > right ? 1 : 0;
+}
+
+function makeBase({ seam, invocation }) {
+  return {
+    schema_version: 1,
+    source_format: 'playwright-json',
+    report_format_contract: 'playwright-json-1.59.1',
+    seam,
+    invocation,
+    unit: 'ms',
+    tests: [],
+    selected_count: null,
+    skipped_count: null,
+    excluded_count: null,
+    excluded_count_reason: 'native_json_does_not_include_excluded_cases',
+    suite_started_at: null,
+    suite_elapsed_ms: null,
+    sum_test_duration_ms: null,
+    complete: false,
+    incomplete_reasons: [],
+    reporter_overhead: {
+      status: 'unmeasured',
+      overhead_ms: null,
+      unit: 'ms',
+      reason: 'paired_same_selection_runs_not_recorded',
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+function addReason(reasons, reason) {
+  if (!reasons.includes(reason)) reasons.push(reason);
+}
+
+/** Validate and normalize a native Playwright 1.59.1 JSON report. */
+export function normalizeReport(report, identity) {
+  const normalized = makeBase(identity ?? {});
+  const reasons = normalized.incomplete_reasons;
+
+  if (!nonEmptyString(normalized.seam) || !nonEmptyString(normalized.invocation)) {
+    addReason(reasons, 'invocation_identity_missing');
+  }
+  if (!isRecord(report) || !isRecord(report.config) || !Array.isArray(report.config.projects)
+    || !Array.isArray(report.suites) || !Array.isArray(report.errors) || !isRecord(report.stats)) {
+    addReason(reasons, 'report_invalid_shape');
+    return normalized;
+  }
+
+  const projects = new Map();
+  for (const project of report.config.projects) {
+    if (!isRecord(project) || !nonEmptyString(project.id) || !nonEmptyString(project.name)
+      || projects.has(project.id) || [...projects.values()].some((existing) => existing.name === project.name)) {
+      addReason(reasons, 'project_identity_invalid');
+      continue;
+    }
+    projects.set(project.id, { id: project.id, name: project.name });
+  }
+
+  const stats = report.stats;
+  const statsCounts = ['expected', 'unexpected', 'flaky', 'skipped'];
+  if (!validDate(stats.startTime) || !Number.isFinite(stats.duration) || stats.duration < 0
+    || statsCounts.some((key) => !Number.isInteger(stats[key]) || stats[key] < 0)) {
+    addReason(reasons, 'report_stats_invalid');
+  } else {
+    normalized.suite_started_at = stats.startTime;
+    normalized.suite_elapsed_ms = stats.duration;
+    normalized.skipped_count = stats.skipped;
+  }
+  if (report.errors.length > 0) addReason(reasons, 'report_has_errors');
+
+  const identities = new Set();
+  let selectedCount = 0;
+  const observedSummaryCounts = { expected: 0, unexpected: 0, flaky: 0, skipped: 0 };
+
+  function visitSuites(suites, ancestors = []) {
+    if (!Array.isArray(suites)) {
+      addReason(reasons, 'suite_invalid_shape');
+      return;
+    }
+    for (const suite of suites) {
+      if (!isRecord(suite) || !nonEmptyString(suite.title) || !nonEmptyString(suite.file)
+        || !Array.isArray(suite.specs) || (suite.suites !== undefined && !Array.isArray(suite.suites))) {
+        addReason(reasons, 'suite_invalid_shape');
+        continue;
+      }
+      const suitePath = [...ancestors, suite.title];
+      for (const spec of suite.specs) {
+        if (!isRecord(spec) || !nonEmptyString(spec.id) || !nonEmptyString(spec.title)
+          || !nonEmptyString(spec.file) || !Array.isArray(spec.tests)) {
+          addReason(reasons, 'spec_invalid_shape');
+          continue;
+        }
+        for (const selectedTest of spec.tests) {
+          selectedCount += 1;
+          if (!isRecord(selectedTest) || !nonEmptyString(selectedTest.projectId)
+            || !nonEmptyString(selectedTest.projectName) || !EXPECTED_STATUSES.has(selectedTest.expectedStatus)
+            || !TEST_SUMMARY_STATUSES.has(selectedTest.status) || !Array.isArray(selectedTest.results)) {
+            addReason(reasons, 'selected_result_missing_or_invalid');
+            continue;
+          }
+          const project = projects.get(selectedTest.projectId);
+          if (!project || project.name !== selectedTest.projectName) addReason(reasons, 'project_identity_mismatch');
+          const testId = JSON.stringify([
+            selectedTest.projectId,
+            safePath(spec.file),
+            suitePath,
+            spec.id,
+            spec.title,
+          ]);
+
+          if (selectedTest.results.length === 0) {
+            if (selectedTest.status !== 'skipped' || selectedTest.expectedStatus !== 'skipped') {
+              addReason(reasons, 'selected_result_missing_or_invalid');
+              continue;
+            }
+            const key = `${testId}\^@unreported`;
+            if (identities.has(key)) addReason(reasons, 'duplicate_result_identity');
+            identities.add(key);
+            normalized.tests.push({
+              test_id: testId,
+              project: selectedTest.projectName,
+              project_id: selectedTest.projectId,
+              seam: normalized.seam,
+              invocation: normalized.invocation,
+              spec_file: safePath(spec.file),
+              suite_path: suitePath,
+              title: spec.title,
+              retry: null,
+              result: 'skipped',
+              duration_ms: null,
+              unit: 'ms',
+              start_time: null,
+            });
+            observedSummaryCounts.skipped += 1;
+            continue;
+          }
+
+          for (const result of selectedTest.results) {
+            if (!isRecord(result) || !Number.isInteger(result.retry) || result.retry < 0
+              || !RESULT_STATUSES.has(result.status) || !Number.isFinite(result.duration) || result.duration < 0
+              || !validDate(result.startTime)) {
+              addReason(reasons, !isRecord(result) || !Number.isFinite(result?.duration) || result?.duration < 0
+                ? 'invalid_duration'
+                : !isRecord(result) || !RESULT_STATUSES.has(result?.status)
+                  ? 'invalid_result_status'
+                  : 'result_identity_or_start_time_invalid');
+              continue;
+            }
+            const key = `${testId}\^@${result.retry}`;
+            if (identities.has(key)) addReason(reasons, 'duplicate_result_identity');
+            identities.add(key);
+            normalized.tests.push({
+              test_id: testId,
+              project: selectedTest.projectName,
+              project_id: selectedTest.projectId,
+              seam: normalized.seam,
+              invocation: normalized.invocation,
+              spec_file: safePath(spec.file),
+              suite_path: suitePath,
+              title: spec.title,
+              retry: result.retry,
+              result: result.status,
+              duration_ms: result.duration,
+              unit: 'ms',
+              start_time: result.startTime,
+            });
+          }
+
+          switch (selectedTest.status) {
+            case 'expected': observedSummaryCounts.expected += 1; break;
+            case 'unexpected': observedSummaryCounts.unexpected += 1; break;
+            case 'flaky': observedSummaryCounts.flaky += 1; break;
+            case 'skipped': observedSummaryCounts.skipped += 1; break;
+          }
+        }
+      }
+      if (suite.suites) visitSuites(suite.suites, suitePath);
+    }
+  }
+
+  visitSuites(report.suites);
+  normalized.selected_count = selectedCount;
+  if (selectedCount === 0) addReason(reasons, 'selected_results_missing');
+  if (statsCounts.every((key) => Number.isInteger(stats[key]) && stats[key] >= 0)
+    && statsCounts.some((key) => observedSummaryCounts[key] !== stats[key])) {
+    addReason(reasons, 'selected_count_mismatch');
+  }
+
+  normalized.tests.sort((left, right) => compareText(left.test_id, right.test_id)
+    || (left.retry ?? -1) - (right.retry ?? -1) || compareText(left.result, right.result));
+  normalized.complete = reasons.length === 0;
+  if (normalized.complete) {
+    normalized.sum_test_duration_ms = normalized.tests.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.duration_ms ?? 0), 0);
+  }
+  return normalized;
+}
+
+async function writeAtomically(outputPath, content) {
+  const destination = resolve(outputPath);
+  const temporary = `${destination}.tmp-${process.pid}-${randomUUID()}`;
+  let handle;
+  try {
+    handle = await open(temporary, 'wx', 0o600);
+    await handle.writeFile(content, 'utf8');
+    await handle.sync();
+    await handle.close();
+    handle = undefined;
+    await rename(temporary, destination);
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (handle) await handle.close().catch(() => {});
+    await unlink(temporary).catch(() => {});
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function parseArgs(args) {
+  const parsed = {};
+  for (let index = 0; index < args.length; index += 1) {
+    const flag = args[index];
+    if (!['--input', '--seam', '--invocation', '--output'].includes(flag)) {
+      throw new Error(`unknown argument: ${flag}`);
+    }
+    if (parsed[flag] !== undefined || !args[index + 1] || args[index + 1].startsWith('--')) {
+      throw new Error(`missing or duplicate value for ${flag}`);
+    }
+    parsed[flag] = args[index + 1];
+    index += 1;
+  }
+  for (const flag of ['--input', '--seam', '--invocation', '--output']) {
+    if (!nonEmptyString(parsed[flag])) throw new Error(`required argument missing: ${flag}`);
+  }
+  const options = {
+    input: parsed['--input'],
+    seam: parsed['--seam'],
+    invocation: parsed['--invocation'],
+    output: parsed['--output'],
+  };
+  if (resolve(options.input) === resolve(options.output)) {
+    throw new Error('input_and_output_must_differ');
+  }
+  return options;
+}
+
+async function runCli(args) {
+  const options = parseArgs(args);
+  let report;
+  let inputError;
+  try {
+    const input = await readFile(options.input, 'utf8');
+    try {
+      report = JSON.parse(input);
+    } catch {
+      inputError = 'input_invalid_json';
+    }
+  } catch (error) {
+    inputError = 'input_unavailable';
+  }
+
+  const normalized = inputError
+    ? makeBase(options)
+    : normalizeReport(report, options);
+  if (inputError) addReason(normalized.incomplete_reasons, inputError);
+  try {
+    await writeAtomically(options.output, `${JSON.stringify(normalized, null, 2)}\n`);
+  } catch (error) {
+    process.stderr.write(`ci-playwright-report: output_write_failed: ${error.message}\n`);
+    return 2;
+  }
+  if (!normalized.complete) {
+    process.stderr.write(`ci-playwright-report: incomplete report: ${normalized.incomplete_reasons.join(', ')}\n`);
+    return 2;
+  }
+  return 0;
+}
+
+if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(resolve(process.argv[1])).href) {
+  runCli(process.argv.slice(2)).then((status) => {
+    process.exitCode = status;
+  }).catch((error) => {
+    process.stderr.write(`ci-playwright-report: ${error.message}\n`);
+    process.exitCode = 2;
+  });
+}",

+"""Validate source-bound ExUnit reports emitted by the two mix ci invocations."""
+
+EXPECTED_REPORTS = {
+    "main": "ci-exunit-timing-main.json",
+    "threadline_guard": "ci-exunit-timing-threadline-guard.json",
+}
+
+
+def validate(metadata, reports, artifact_names, run_id, attempt):
+    diagnostics = []
+    expected_metadata = [
+        {"invocation": invocation, "path": filename}
+        for invocation, filename in EXPECTED_REPORTS.items()
+    ]
+    if metadata.get("exunit_reports") != expected_metadata:
+        diagnostics.append("exunit_producer_report_contract_missing")
+
+    expected_artifact = f"library-test-timing-{run_id}-{attempt}"
+    if metadata.get("timing_artifact_name") != expected_artifact or any(
+        artifact_names.get(invocation) != expected_artifact
+        for invocation in EXPECTED_REPORTS
+    ):
+        diagnostics.append("exunit_timing_artifact_not_bound_to_library_job")
+
+    normalized = {}
+    summaries = []
+    rows = []
+    for invocation in EXPECTED_REPORTS:
+        report = reports.get(invocation)
+        if (
+            not isinstance(report, dict)
+            or report.get("complete") is not True
+            or report.get("unit") != "microsecond"
+            or report.get("invocation") != invocation
+        ):
+            diagnostics.append(
+                f"complete_exunit_{invocation}_timing_missing_or_wrong_invocation"
+            )
+            continue
+
+        report_rows = report.get("tests")
+        if not isinstance(report_rows, list) or any(
+            not isinstance(row, dict)
+            or row.get("invocation") != invocation
+            or not isinstance(row.get("test_id"), str)
+            or not isinstance(row.get("duration_us"), int)
+            or row.get("duration_us") < 0
+            for row in report_rows
+        ):
+            diagnostics.append(f"exunit_{invocation}_test_identity_invalid")
+            continue
+        if report.get("test_duration_sum_us") != sum(
+            row["duration_us"] for row in report_rows
+        ):
+            diagnostics.append(f"exunit_{invocation}_duration_total_mismatch")
+            continue
+
+        normalized[invocation] = report
+        summaries.append(
+            {
+                "invocation": invocation,
+                "tests": len(report_rows),
+                "passed": report.get("passed_count"),
+                "failed": report.get("failed_count"),
+                "skipped": report.get("skipped_count"),
+                "excluded": report.get("excluded_count"),
+                "suite_elapsed_us": report.get("suite_elapsed_us"),
+                "test_duration_sum_us": report.get("test_duration_sum_us"),
+            }
+        )
+        for row in report_rows:
+            rows.append({**row, "identity": f"{invocation}:{row['test_id']}"})
+
+    return {
+        "valid": not diagnostics and len(normalized) == len(EXPECTED_REPORTS),
+        "diagnostics": sorted(set(diagnostics)),
+        "reports": summaries,
+        "tests": rows,
+        "normalized": normalized,

+    end)
+
+    System.put_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON", path)
+    System.put_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION", "main")
+    {:ok, state} = CITimingFormatter.init([])
+    {:noreply, state} = CITimingFormatter.handle_cast({:suite_started, []}, state)
+
+    {:noreply, state} =
+      CITimingFormatter.handle_cast({:test_finished, event_test(:main_test, nil, 11)}, state)
+
+    {:noreply, _state} = CITimingFormatter.handle_cast({:suite_finished, %{run: 20}}, state)
+
+    report = path |> File.read!() |> Jason.decode!()

+  test "writes distinct completed test results only after the suite finishes" do

+    {:noreply, state} =

+    {:noreply, state} =

+    refute File.exists?(path)

+    {:noreply, _state} =

+defmodule Sigra.Test.CITimingFormatter do
+  @moduledoc false
+
+  use GenServer
+
+  @unit "microsecond"
+  @count_keys [:passed, :failed, :skipped, :excluded]
+
+  @doc false
+  def new_state(path, invocation \\ System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION")) do
+    %{
+      path: path,
+      invocation: invocation,
+      tests: [],
+      counts: Map.new(@count_keys, &{&1, 0}),
+      test_duration_sum_us: 0,
+      diagnostics: [],
+      started_at_us: nil,
+      aborted?: false
+    }
+  end
+
+  @impl true
+  def init(_opts) do
+    path = System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON")
+    state = new_state(path, System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION"))
+
+    case clear_previous_report(path) do
+      :ok ->
+        {:ok, state}
+
+      {:error, reason} ->
+        report_write_error(reason)
+        {:ok, add_diagnostic(state, "previous_output_unavailable")}
+    end
+  end
+
+  @impl true
+  def handle_cast({:suite_started, _opts}, state) do
+    {:noreply, %{state | started_at_us: System.monotonic_time(:microsecond)}}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:test_finished, %ExUnit.Test{} = test}, state) do
+    id = test_id(test)
+    result = result(test.state)
+    state = update_in(state.counts[result], &(&1 + 1))
+
+    if result == :excluded do
+      {:noreply, state}
+    else
+      case test.time do
+        time when is_integer(time) and time >= 0 ->
+          row = %{
+            invocation: state.invocation,
+            test_id: id,
+            module: inspect(test.module),
+            name: Atom.to_string(test.name),
+            result: Atom.to_string(result),
+            duration_us: time,
+            unit: @unit
+          }
+
+          state =
+            state
+            |> update_in([:tests], &[row | &1])
+            |> update_in([:test_duration_sum_us], &(&1 + time))
+
+          {:noreply, state}
+
+        _ ->
+          {:noreply, add_diagnostic(state, "test_duration_unavailable:#{id}")}
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:max_failures_reached, _}, state) do
+    {:noreply, state |> Map.put(:aborted?, true) |> add_diagnostic("max_failures_reached")}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast(:max_failures_reached, state) do
+    {:noreply, state |> Map.put(:aborted?, true) |> add_diagnostic("max_failures_reached")}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:suite_finished, times_us}, state) do
+    report = build_report(state, times_us, true)
+    write_report(state.path, report)
+    {:noreply, state}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:sigquit, _current}, state) do
+    state = state |> Map.put(:aborted?, true) |> add_diagnostic("suite_interrupted")
+    write_report(state.path, build_report(state, %{}, false))
+    {:noreply, state}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast(_event, state), do: {:noreply, state}
+
+  defp build_report(state, times_us, suite_finished?) do
+    {run_us, diagnostics} = measured_time(times_us, :run, state.diagnostics)
+    {async_us, diagnostics} = measured_time(times_us, :async, diagnostics, optional: true)
+    {load_us, diagnostics} = measured_time(times_us, :load, diagnostics, optional: true)
+
+    suite_elapsed_us =
+      case {state.started_at_us, suite_finished?} do
+        {started_at_us, true} when is_integer(started_at_us) ->
+          max(System.monotonic_time(:microsecond) - started_at_us, 0)
+
+        _ ->
+          nil
+      end
+
+    diagnostics =
+      if is_nil(suite_elapsed_us) and suite_finished? do
+        ["suite_elapsed_unavailable" | diagnostics]
+      else
+        diagnostics
+      end
+
+    %{
+      unit: @unit,
+      invocation: state.invocation,
+      tests: Enum.reverse(state.tests),
+      counts: Map.new(state.counts, fn {key, value} -> {Atom.to_string(key), value} end),
+      passed_count: state.counts.passed,
+      failed_count: state.counts.failed,
+      skipped_count: state.counts.skipped,
+      excluded_count: state.counts.excluded,
+      suite_elapsed_us: suite_elapsed_us,
+      run_us: run_us,
+      async_us: async_us,
+      load_us: load_us,
+      test_duration_sum_us: state.test_duration_sum_us,
+      complete: suite_finished? and not state.aborted? and diagnostics == [],
+      diagnostics: Enum.reverse(diagnostics)
+    }
+  end
+
+  defp measured_time(times_us, key, diagnostics, opts \\ []) do
+    case {Map.get(times_us, key), opts[:optional]} do
+      {value, _optional} when is_integer(value) and value >= 0 ->
+        {value, diagnostics}
+
+      {nil, true} ->
+        {nil, diagnostics}
+
+      _ ->
+        {nil, ["#{key}_time_unavailable" | diagnostics]}
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp result(nil), do: :passed
+  defp result({:failed, _}), do: :failed
+  defp result({:invalid, _}), do: :failed
+  defp result({:skipped, _}), do: :skipped
+  defp result({:excluded, _}), do: :excluded
+  defp result(_), do: :failed
+
+  defp test_id(%ExUnit.Test{module: module, name: name}),
+    do: "#{inspect(module)}.#{Atom.to_string(name)}"
+
+  defp add_diagnostic(state, diagnostic),
+    do: update_in(state.diagnostics, &[diagnostic | &1])
+
+  defp clear_previous_report(path) when is_binary(path) and path != "" do
+    case File.rm(path) do
+      :ok -> :ok
+      {:error, :enoent} -> :ok
+      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp clear_previous_report(_path), do: :ok
+
+  defp write_report(path, report) when is_binary(path) and path != "" do
+    temporary_path = path <> ".tmp." <> Integer.to_string(System.unique_integer([:positive]))
+    contents = Jason.encode!(report)
+
+    case File.write(temporary_path, contents, [:binary, :exclusive]) do
+      :ok ->
+        case File.rename(temporary_path, path) do
+          :ok ->
+            :ok
+
+          {:error, reason} ->
+            File.rm(temporary_path)
+            report_write_error(reason)
+        end
+
+      {:error, reason} ->
+        report_write_error(reason)
+    end
+  rescue
+    _ -> report_write_error(:encoding_failed)
+  end
+
+  defp write_report(_path, _report), do: report_write_error(:output_path_missing)
+
+  defp report_write_error(reason) do
+    diagnostic =
+      if reason == :output_path_missing, do: "output_path_missing", else: "write_failed"
+
+    message =
+      Jason.encode!(%{
+        complete: false,
+        diagnostic: diagnostic,
+        reason: reason |> :file.format_error() |> List.to_string()
+      })
+
+    IO.puts(:stderr, "SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON: #{message}")
+
+    :error
+  end
+end",

<% :already_confirmed -> %> <.header> {dgettext("sigra", "Email already confirmed")} <:subtitle> {dgettext("sigra", "Your email was already confirmed. You can log in below.")}

<% :expired -> %> <.header> {dgettext("sigra", "Confirmation link expired")} <:subtitle> {dgettext("sigra", "This confirmation link has expired or was already used.")} <.sigra_auth_button phx-click="resend" phx-disable-with={dgettext("sigra", "Sending...")} class="sigra-auth-action sigra-auth-action--primary sigra-auth-action--block"> {dgettext("sigra", "Send new confirmation email")} → <% end %>
""" end def mount(_params, _session, socket) do form = to_form(%{"code" => ""}, as: "confirmation") link_form = to_form(%{}, as: "confirmation_link") {:ok, assign(socket, form: form, link_form: link_form, live_action: :new)} end def handle_params(%{"token" => token}, _uri, socket) do {:noreply, assign(socket, confirmation_token: token, live_action: :confirm)} end def handle_params(_params, _uri, socket) do {:noreply, socket} end def handle_event("confirm_link", _params, socket) do case Auth.confirm_user(socket.assigns.confirmation_token) do {:ok, _user} -> {:noreply, socket |> put_flash(:info, dgettext("sigra", "Your email has been confirmed.")) |> assign(live_action: :confirmed)} {:error, :already_confirmed} -> {:noreply, assign(socket, live_action: :already_confirmed)} {:error, :token_expired} -> {:noreply, assign(socket, live_action: :expired)} {:error, :token_invalid} -> {:noreply, socket |> put_flash(:error, dgettext("sigra", "This confirmation link is invalid or has expired.")) |> assign(live_action: :new)} end end def handle_event("validate", %{"confirmation" => %{"code" => code}}, socket) do form = to_form(%{"code" => code}, as: "confirmation") {:noreply, assign(socket, form: form)} end def handle_event("confirm", %{"confirmation" => %{"code" => code}}, socket) do do_confirm(socket, code) end def handle_event("confirm", _params, socket) do do_confirm(socket, "") end def handle_event("resend", _params, socket) do with_confirmation_user(socket, fn socket, user -> case Auth.deliver_user_confirmation_instructions(user, &url(socket, ~p"/users/confirm/#{&1}")) do {:ok, _} -> {:noreply, put_flash(socket, :info, dgettext("sigra", "A new confirmation email has been sent."))} {:error, :already_confirmed} -> {:noreply, socket |> put_flash(:info, dgettext("sigra", "Your email is already confirmed.")) |> redirect(to: ~p"/")} end end) end defp do_confirm(socket, code) do with_confirmation_user(socket, fn socket, user -> do_confirm_user(socket, user, code) end) end defp do_confirm_user(socket, user, code) when is_binary(code) do normalized_code = String.replace(code, " ", "") if Regex.match?(~r/\A[0-9]{6}\z/, normalized_code) do case Auth.confirm_user_by_code(user, normalized_code) do {:ok, _user} -> {:noreply, socket |> put_flash(:info, dgettext("sigra", "Your email has been confirmed.")) |> assign(live_action: :confirmed)} {:error, :invalid_code} -> invalid_code_response(socket, code) {:error, :rate_limited} -> {:noreply, socket |> put_flash(:error, dgettext("sigra", "Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.")) |> assign(form: to_form(%{"code" => code}, as: "confirmation"))} {:error, :already_confirmed} -> {:noreply, socket |> put_flash(:info, dgettext("sigra", "Your email is already confirmed.")) |> assign(live_action: :confirmed)} end else invalid_code_response(socket, code) end end defp do_confirm_user(socket, _user, _code), do: invalid_code_response(socket, "") defp invalid_code_response(socket, code) do {:noreply, socket |> put_flash(:error, dgettext("sigra", "Invalid confirmation code. Please try again.")) |> assign(form: to_form(%{"code" => code}, as: "confirmation"))} end defp with_confirmation_user(socket, callback) do case socket.assigns[:current_scope] do %{user: user} when not is_nil(user) -> callback.(socket, user) _ -> {:noreply, assign(socket, :live_action, :sign_in_required)} end end end

defmodule SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.RegistrationLive do use SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb, :live_view import SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.SigraAuthComponents alias SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.User def render(assigns) do ~H""" <.sigra_auth_page flash={@flash}>
<.header> Register <:subtitle> Already registered? <.link navigate={~p"/users/log_in"}> Log in to your account now. <.form :let={f} for={@form} id="registration_form" phx-submit="save" phx-change="validate" phx-trigger-action={@trigger_submit} action={~p"/users/log_in?_action=registered"} method="post" class="sigra-auth-stack sigra-auth-stack--4" >

We couldn't create your account. Check the highlighted fields and try again.

<% # Add custom fields here (e.g., :name, :company) %> <.input field={f[:email]} type="email" label="Email" autocomplete="username" required /> <.input field={f[:password]} type="password" label="Password" autocomplete="new-password" required /> <% # Password strength indicator %>
{password_strength_label(@password_strength)}
  • {suggestion}
<.sigra_auth_button phx-disable-with="Creating account..." class="sigra-auth-action sigra-auth-action--primary sigra-auth-action--block"> Create an account →
""" end def mount(_params, _session, socket) do changeset = SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.change_user_registration(%User{}) socket = socket |> assign(trigger_submit: false, check_errors: false) |> assign(passkey_primary_enabled: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.passkey_primary_enabled?()) |> assign(enroll_passkey_after_signup: false) |> assign(password_strength: nil, password_suggestions: []) |> assign_form(changeset) {:ok, socket, temporary_assigns: [form: nil]} end def handle_event("save", %{"user" => user_params}, socket) do enroll_passkey = Map.get(user_params, "enroll_passkey") in ["true", true, "on", "1"] case SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.register_user(user_params) do {:ok, user} -> # Deliver confirmation email (helper exists at SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.deliver_user_confirmation_instructions/2) confirmation_url_fun = fn token -> if enroll_passkey do url(socket, ~p"/users/confirm/#{token}?enroll_passkey=1") else url(socket, ~p"/users/confirm/#{token}") end end case SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.deliver_user_confirmation_instructions(user, confirmation_url_fun) do {:ok, :sent} -> :ok {:error, :already_confirmed} -> :ok end changeset = SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.change_user_registration(user) {:noreply, socket |> assign(trigger_submit: true) |> assign_form(changeset)} {:error, :email_taken} -> # Enumeration-safe: show generic message changeset = SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.change_user_registration(%User{}) {:noreply, socket |> put_flash(:info, "If this email is available, your account has been created. Please check your email.") |> assign_form(changeset)} {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset} -> {:noreply, socket |> assign(check_errors: true) |> assign_form(changeset)} end end def handle_event("validate", %{"user" => user_params}, socket) do changeset = SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.change_user_registration(%User{}, user_params) enroll_passkey = Map.get(user_params, "enroll_passkey") in ["true", true, "on", "1"] # Real-time password strength feedback {strength, suggestions} = case Map.get(user_params, "password", "") do "" -> {nil, []} password -> Sigra.PasswordPolicy.check_strength(password) end {:noreply, socket |> assign(password_strength: strength, password_suggestions: suggestions) |> assign(enroll_passkey_after_signup: enroll_passkey) |> assign_form(Map.put(changeset, :action, :validate))} end defp assign_form(socket, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset) do form = to_form(changeset, as: "user") if changeset.valid? do assign(socket, form: form, check_errors: false) else assign(socket, form: form) end end defp password_strength_color(:weak), do: "sigra-auth-meter__value--weak" defp password_strength_color(:fair), do: "sigra-auth-meter__value--fair" defp password_strength_color(:strong), do: "sigra-auth-meter__value--strong" defp password_strength_color(_), do: "" defp password_strength_width(:weak), do: 33 defp password_strength_width(:fair), do: 66 defp password_strength_width(:strong), do: 100 defp password_strength_width(_), do: 0 defp password_strength_label(:weak), do: "Weak" defp password_strength_label(:fair), do: "Fair" defp password_strength_label(:strong), do: "Strong" defp password_strength_label(_), do: "" defp password_strength_text_color(:weak), do: "sigra-auth-status--danger" defp password_strength_text_color(:fair), do: "sigra-auth-status--warning" defp password_strength_text_color(:strong), do: "sigra-auth-status--success" defp password_strength_text_color(_), do: "" end

defmodule SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.Router do
  use SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb, :router

  import SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.UserAuth

  pipeline :browser do
    plug :accepts, ["html"]
    plug :fetch_session
    plug :fetch_live_flash
    plug :put_root_layout, html: {SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.Layouts, :root}
    plug :protect_from_forgery
    plug :put_secure_browser_headers
    plug :fetch_current_scope
  end

  pipeline :api do
    plug :accepts, ["json"]
  end

  scope "/", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through :browser

    get "/", PageController, :home
  end

  # Other scopes may use custom stacks.
  # scope "/api", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
  #   pipe_through :api
  # end

  # Enable LiveDashboard and Swoosh mailbox preview in development
  if Application.compile_env(:sigra_install_golden_tmp, :dev_routes) do
    # If you want to use the LiveDashboard in production, you should put
    # it behind authentication and allow only admins to access it.
    # If your application does not have an admins-only section yet,
    # you can use Plug.BasicAuth to set up some basic authentication
    # as long as you are also using SSL (which you should anyway).
    import Phoenix.LiveDashboard.Router

    scope "/dev" do
      pipe_through :browser

      live_dashboard "/dashboard", metrics: SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.Telemetry
      forward "/mailbox", Plug.Swoosh.MailboxPreview
    end
  end

  # Sigra authentication

  pipeline :require_authenticated do
    plug :require_authenticated_user
    plug :require_mfa
  end

  pipeline :require_sudo do
    plug Sigra.Plug.RequireSudo, error_handler: SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.AuthErrorHandler
  end

  pipeline :require_mfa_capability do
    plug :ensure_mfa_capability
  end

  pipeline :require_passkeys_capability do
    plug :ensure_passkeys_capability
  end

  pipeline :require_auth_settings_capability do
    plug :ensure_auth_settings_capability
  end

  # Opt-in organization-aware pipelines.
  # Apps that want to gate routes by active organization membership
  # pipe_through :require_org (any active membership) or
  # :require_org_owner (owner role only). These wire into
  # the organization picker + switcher.
  pipeline :require_org do
    plug Sigra.Plug.RequireMembership, error_handler: SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.AuthErrorHandler
  end

  pipeline :require_org_owner do
    plug Sigra.Plug.RequireMembership,
      error_handler: SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.AuthErrorHandler,
      roles: [:owner]
  end

  # MFA challenge (accessible with mfa_pending sessions)
  scope "/users", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_mfa_capability]

    live "/mfa", MFAChallengeLive

  end


    scope "/users", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
      pipe_through [:browser]

      live_session :sigra_confirmation,
        on_mount: [{SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.UserAuth, :mount_current_scope}] do

    live "/confirm", ConfirmationLive
    live "/confirm/:token", ConfirmationLive, :confirm

      end
    end


  scope "/users", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :redirect_if_user_is_authenticated]

    # Login page is a plain controller, not a LiveView.
    get "/log_in", SessionController, :new

    live "/register", RegistrationLive

    post "/log_in", SessionController, :create
    get "/log_in/:token", SessionController, :magic_link


    live "/reset-password", ResetPasswordLive
    live "/reset-password/:token", ResetPasswordLive, :edit

  end

  scope "/users", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated]

    delete "/log_out", SessionController, :delete

    live "/sessions", Auth.SessionLive, :index

      get "/sudo", Auth.SudoController, :new
      post "/sudo", Auth.SudoController, :create

    live "/settings", SettingsLive, :edit
    live "/reactivation", ReactivationLive

  end

  scope "/users", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_auth_settings_capability, :require_authenticated, :require_sudo]

    live "/settings/mfa", MFASettingsLive

  end


  # Single unscoped InvitationAcceptLive at
  # /invitations/:token/accept. This route MUST remain outside any
  # `:require_authenticated` pipeline so both anonymous visitors
  # (signup branch) and signed-in visitors (accept / mismatch branch)
  # reach the same LiveView, which branches on `@branch` at mount.
  scope "/", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser]

    live_session :invitations_public,
      on_mount: [{SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.UserAuth, :mount_current_scope}] do
      live "/invitations/:token/accept", InvitationAcceptLive
    end
  end

  # Sigra organizations
  pipeline :org_scoped do
    plug Sigra.Plug.LoadOrganizationFromSlug,
      error_handler: SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.AuthErrorHandler,
      organizations: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Organizations,
      session_store: Sigra.SessionStores.Ecto,
      session_store_opts: [repo: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Repo, session_schema: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.UserSession],
      scope_module: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.Scope

    plug Sigra.Plug.RequireMembership,
      error_handler: SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.AuthErrorHandler
  end

  scope "/", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated]

    # POST /organizations/switch MUST be defined before the scoped block
    # below so Phoenix's definition-order matching doesn't interpret
    # "switch" as a slug.
    post "/organizations/switch", OrganizationSwitchController, :update

    live_session :organizations_unscoped,
      on_mount: [
        {SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.UserAuth, :ensure_authenticated},
        {SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.UserAuth, :assign_user_organizations}
      ] do
      live "/organizations", OrganizationsLive.Index, :index
      live "/organizations/new", OrganizationsLive.New, :new
    end
  end

  scope "/organizations/:org", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser]

    get "/sso", EnterpriseSSOController, :new
    post "/sso", EnterpriseSSOController, :create
    get "/sso/callback", EnterpriseSSOController, :callback
  end

  scope "/organizations/:org", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated, :org_scoped]

    live_session :organization_scoped,
      on_mount: [
        {SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.UserAuth, :ensure_authenticated},
        {SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.UserAuth, :assign_user_organizations},
        {Sigra.LiveView.OrganizationScope,
         [organizations: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Organizations, scope_module: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.Scope]}
      ] do
      live "/settings", OrganizationSettingsLive, :edit
      live "/members", OrganizationMembersLive, :index
    end
  end


# Sigra passkeys
scope "/users", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
  pipe_through [:browser, :require_mfa_capability, :require_passkeys_capability]

  post "/mfa/passkey", SessionController, :complete_mfa_passkey
  post "/mfa/passkey/options", SessionController, :passkey_mfa_options
end

scope "/users", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
  pipe_through [:browser, :require_passkeys_capability, :redirect_if_user_is_authenticated]

  post "/log_in/passkey", SessionController, :complete_passkey
  post "/log_in/passkey/options", SessionController, :passkey_authentication_options
end

scope "/users", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
  pipe_through [:browser, :require_passkeys_capability, :require_authenticated, :require_sudo]

  post "/settings/mfa/passkeys/options", SessionController, :passkey_registration_options
  post "/settings/mfa/passkeys", SessionController, :complete_passkey_registration
  post "/settings/mfa/passkeys/:id/delete", SessionController, :delete_passkey
end


  pipeline :admin_global do
    plug Sigra.Plug.RequireAdminAccess,
      error_handler: SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.AuthErrorHandler,
      policy: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.SigraAdminPolicy,
      mode: :global
  end

  pipeline :admin_organization do
    plug Sigra.Plug.RequireAdminAccess,
      error_handler: SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.AuthErrorHandler,
      policy: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.SigraAdminPolicy,
      mode: :organization,
      organizations: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Organizations
  end

  # Sigra admin
  scope "/", alias: false do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated, :admin_global]

    post "/admin/users/:id/impersonation", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.Admin.ImpersonationController, :create
    get "/admin/audit/export.csv", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.Admin.AuditExportController, :index
    get "/admin/users/:id/audit/export.csv", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.Admin.AuditExportController, :index
  end

  scope "/", alias: false do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated, :admin_global]

    live_session :admin_global,
      layout: {SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.Layouts, :admin},
      on_mount: [
        {SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.UserAuth, :ensure_authenticated},
        {Sigra.LiveView.AdminScope,
         [mode: :global, policy: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.SigraAdminPolicy, login_path: "/users/log_in"]}
      ] do
      live "/admin", Elixir.Sigra.Admin.Live.IndexLive, :index
      live "/admin/audit", Elixir.Sigra.Admin.Live.AuditIndexLive, :index
      live "/admin/auth-branding", Elixir.Sigra.Admin.Live.BrandingLive, :index
      live "/admin/users", Elixir.Sigra.Admin.Live.UsersIndexLive, :index
      live "/admin/users/:id", Elixir.Sigra.Admin.Live.UserShowLive, :show
      live "/admin/users/:id/audit", Elixir.Sigra.Admin.Live.AuditUserLive, :show
      live "/admin/users/:id/sessions", Elixir.Sigra.Admin.Live.UserSessionsLive, :show
    end
  end

  scope "/admin/organizations/:org", alias: false do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated, :admin_organization]

    post "/users/:id/impersonation", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.Admin.ImpersonationController, :create
    get "/audit/export.csv", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.Admin.AuditExportController, :index
    get "/users/:id/audit/export.csv", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.Admin.AuditExportController, :index
  end

  scope "/admin/organizations/:org", alias: false do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated, :admin_organization]

    live_session :admin_organization,
      layout: {SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.Layouts, :admin},
      on_mount: [
        {SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.UserAuth, :ensure_authenticated},
        {Sigra.LiveView.AdminScope,
         [
           mode: :organization,
           organizations: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Organizations,
           policy: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.SigraAdminPolicy,
           login_path: "/users/log_in"
         ]}
      ] do
      live "/", Elixir.Sigra.Admin.Live.OrganizationLive, :show
      live "/audit", Elixir.Sigra.Admin.Live.AuditIndexLive, :index
      live "/users", Elixir.Sigra.Admin.Live.UsersIndexLive, :index
      live "/users/:id", Elixir.Sigra.Admin.Live.UserShowLive, :show
      live "/users/:id/audit", Elixir.Sigra.Admin.Live.AuditUserLive, :show
      live "/users/:id/sessions", Elixir.Sigra.Admin.Live.UserSessionsLive, :show
    end
  end

  scope "/", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated]

    delete "/impersonation", Admin.ImpersonationController, :delete
  end

end

# Phase 230 (D-23): the honest-skip set, as data.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# `ci-gate` counts a `skipped` conclusion as a pass, so "this lane was skipped" is
# indistinguishable from "this lane passed" unless the legitimate skips are enumerated
# somewhere a machine can read. That enumeration used to live only as prose in
# MAINTAINING.md. Prose is now a RENDERER of this file, not a second source of truth:
# scripts/ci/prohibitions/p21-honest-skip-parity.test.mjs asserts
# manifest <=> ci.yml <=> MAINTAINING.md and fails in every direction (an undocumented
# demotion, a stale doc entry, or a manifest row naming a construct ci.yml does not have).
#
# CONSUMERS
#   - scripts/ci/ci-demotion-observer.sh                   reads the `assert` rows to
#                                                          decide what must have executed
#                                                          on a non-pull_request run
#   - scripts/ci/prohibitions/p21-honest-skip-parity.test.mjs   three-way parity guard
#   - Phase 231 GATE-03                                    SHOULD read this file rather
#                                                          than re-deriving the set.
#                                                          GATE-03 owns the `ci-gate`
#                                                          pass/fail consequence; this
#                                                          file owns the enumeration.
#                                                          The pull_request half belongs
#                                                          in GATE-03, not here.
#
# TIERS
#   A  event-gated, pre-existing (Phase 196). NOT demoted by Phase 230. Phase 231's
#      GATE-01/GATE-02 own these; the observer deliberately does NOT assert on them --
#      asserting would add a tenth red to a 0-pass/9-fail nightly, which is the
#      unread-noise failure this milestone exists to remove.
#   B  event-gated, demoted BY Phase 230. These are exactly what AFTER-PUSH must observe
#      executing on the receiving lane.
#   C  diff-gated (docs-only). Skips on the CONTENT of the diff rather than the event --
#      a different audit question from A/B.
#
# COLUMNS (TAB-separated; `#` and blank lines are comments)
#   tier           A | B | C
#   kind           job | step
#   id             the ci.yml job id, or the step `id:` when kind=step. Every id here
#                  MUST resolve in ci.yml -- the parity guard asserts it, which is what
#                  stops this file from drifting into fiction.
#   parent_job_id  owning job id when kind=step; `-` when kind=job. A step row's parent
#                  MUST also appear here as a kind=job row -- that is how the observer
#                  resolves the parent's display_name (the Actions API returns names,
#                  never ids).
#   display_name   the job `name:` / step `name:` EXACTLY as ci.yml spells it. The
#                  parity guard pins id and display_name adjacent in ci.yml so the
#                  API-facing lookup cannot rot independently of the id-facing guard.
#   gate_level     job | step -- WHERE the predicate is applied. For the four
#                  ruleset-required tier-C lanes this MUST stay `step`: a job-level
#                  docs_only gate would make the required context `skipped` and can
#                  strand a PR under ruleset 14941512 (D-06).
#   gate           the literal gating predicate, normalized (${{ }} stripped, whitespace
#                  collapsed)
#   observer       assert | exempt | ignore
#                    assert = must have executed on a non-PR run (tier B only)
#                    exempt = event-gated but ALSO outcome-gated, so a skip on a healthy
#                             run is CORRECT -- never assert
#                    ignore = outside the observer's scope (tier A / tier C)
#
tier	kind	id	parent_job_id	display_name	gate_level	gate	observer
A	job	install_matrix_renamed	-	Install matrix (flag combinations)	job	github.event_name != 'pull_request'	ignore
A	job	upgrade_smoke	-	Upgrade smoke (published source series -> local candidate)	job	github.event_name != 'pull_request'	ignore

### Honest-skip set after Phase 230 (v1.47 FAST-02/FAST-03/FAST-05)

`ci-gate` counts a `skipped` conclusion as a pass (the `ci-gate` job's result loop treats
`"$result" != "success" && "$result" != "skipped"` as the only failing case), so the tiers below are the
enumerated baseline against which Phase 231's GATE-03 distinguishes "skipped because correctly
gated for this event" from "skipped because its gate rotted", and against which Phase 235's
GATE-05 builds its before/after coverage inventory. Every entry names the construct (job id or
step id) and its literal gating condition, verified against the shipped `ci.yml` at the commit
this section was written.

<!-- honest-skip-active-ids:start -->
- `install_matrix`
- `upgrade_smoke`
- `passkeys_manual_fallback_smoke`
- `passkeys_opt_out_smoke`
- `nightly_probe`
- `admin_design_recapture`
- `admin_checkpoint_recapture`
- `notify_release_lane_rot`
- `admin_eval_render`
- `design_gallery_snapshots`
- `example_playwright_shard`
- `library_tests_dep_off`
- `example_unit_smoke`
- `install_smoke`
- `example_http_smoke`
- `example_playwright_smoke`
- `retired_skip_lane`
<!-- honest-skip-active-ids:end -->

**Tier A — event-gated, pre-existing (Phase 196).** `install_matrix`, `upgrade_smoke`,
`passkeys_manual_fallback_smoke`, `passkeys_opt_out_smoke`, `nightly_probe`, plus the two
recapture lanes (`admin_design_recapture`, `admin_checkpoint_recapture`) and
`notify_release_lane_rot` — all gated to non-`pull_request` events. The "CI cadence" enumeration
above is the authority for this tier; it is repeated here only so the post-Phase-230 honest-skip
set reads as one list. `generated_admin_playwright_smoke` is no longer in this tier: Phase 231
GATE-02 / D-06 deleted its `if:` condition outright (not replaced), so it now runs on every
event, including `pull_request`, gated by nothing.

**Tier B — event-gated, added by Phase 230.**

- The job `admin_eval_render` (`Admin eval render + probe (hard signal on push/schedule/dispatch;
  not in ci-gate)`) — `if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'` — newly gated to non-`pull_request`
  events, removing a measured 17m33s from every PR (FAST-03, D-10). It is not in `ci-gate.needs`
  and is not a ruleset context, so a failure here never blocks a merge and this job never runs on
  a `pull_request` event at all — but as of Phase 231 GATE-04 (D-11 step 4), the JOB-level
  `continue-on-error: true` that used to mask a harness failure is gone: on push, schedule, and
  `workflow_dispatch` runs, a harness failure now reddens this job's own conclusion. The
  STEP-level `continue-on-error: true` under `id: admin_eval_harness` (D-13) is retained
  permanently so partial evidence bundles still upload as artifacts before the re-fail step turns
  the job red.
- The step `design_gallery_snapshots` ("Run design gallery board snapshots (non-PR)") inside
  `example_playwright_smoke` — `id: design_gallery_snapshots`,
  `if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true' }}`
  — newly gated to non-`pull_request` events, carrying the 84 per-board pixel-diff snapshot
  assertions (FAST-02, D-01/D-04). Its step id is in the seam-outcome aggregator's hard-coded
  outcome list (the `Aggregate Playwright step outcomes` step's `for o in ...` loop inside
  `example_playwright_smoke`), so a snapshot regression on `main` still reds the
  ruleset-required "Example Playwright smoke (full lifecycle)" context. The WCAG axe scan and the
  L1-state behaviour half of the same spec (`design_gallery`, filtered
  `--grep-invert '@snapshot'`) still run on every PR in the sibling step.

**Tier C — diff-gated (docs-only), added by Phase 230.** These skip on the *content of the diff*
(a new `changes` job's `docs_only` output) rather than on the event, which is a different audit
question from Tier A/B. Gated:

- The heavy steps (deps cache through the test-running step) of the four app-behaviour
  ruleset-required lanes — `example_unit_smoke`, `install_smoke`, `example_http_smoke`,
  `example_playwright_smoke` — each guarded `if: needs.changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true'` (with
  `!cancelled()` composed in where the job also carries other conditions). Gated at step level, not
  job level, so all four required contexts still run and conclude `success`.
- The whole `library_tests_dep_off` job —
  `if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.release_ref_guard.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true' }}`
  — gated at job level, permitted because it is not a ruleset-required context (D-08).

**Fail-open polarity:** an empty, missing, or non-`'true'` `docs_only` output runs every heavy
step and job above. Only an explicit `docs_only == 'true'` skips them.

**Not skipped.** `fast_checks` and `library_tests`/`library_tests_shard` are deliberately exempt
from Tier C and carry no `changes` dependency: their guards (`milestone-verification-gate.sh`,
`getting-started-contract.sh`) and the ExUnit files under `test/sigra/planning/` and
`test/sigra/*guides*` read `.planning/**` and `guides/**` directly — the exact paths a docs-only
PR changes. Gating either job would remove coverage in the one dimension the change touches.

See `.planning/phases/230-tier-1-critical-path-reclamation/230-EVIDENCE.md` for the observed-run
evidence backing each of these claims.

name: Boot example app for Playwright
description: Prepare, boot, and warm the repository example app for Playwright consumers.

inputs:
  database-name:
    description: Runner-local PostgreSQL database name.
    required: true
  database-port:
    description: Runner-local PostgreSQL port.
    required: false
    default: "5432"
  app-port:
    description: Port compiled into and used by the Phoenix endpoint.
    required: true
  base-url:
    description: Absolute URL used for readiness and Playwright.
    required: true
  server-log:
    description: Absolute path receiving Phoenix stdout and stderr.
    required: true
  browsers:
    description: Space-separated Playwright browser binaries to install.
    required: false
    default: chromium webkit
  cache-browsers:
    description: Whether to cache Playwright browser downloads.
    required: false
    default: "false"
  browser-cache-key:
    description: Exact browser cache key when cache-browsers is true.
    required: false
    default: ""
  warmup-paths:
    description: Space-separated application paths warmed after readiness.
    required: false
    default: /users/register /users/log_in /users/confirm /dev/mailbox /users/sessions /users/sudo /users/settings/mfa /admin/users

outputs:
  deps_cache_hit:
    description: Exact example dependency cache hit.
    value: ${{ steps.example_deps_cache.outputs.cache-hit }}
  browser_cache_hit:
    description: Exact Playwright browser cache hit, or false when disabled.
    value: ${{ steps.browser_cache_result.outputs.hit }}

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: erlef/setup-beam@54075bcc5e249e4758d363f27d099f55d843f124 # v1.24.1
      id: setup_beam
      with:
        version-file: .tool-versions
        version-type: strict

    - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
      with:
        node-version: "20"
        cache: npm
        cache-dependency-path: test/example/priv/playwright/package-lock.json

    - name: Cache example dependencies
      id: example_deps_cache
      uses: actions/cache@v6 # v6.1.0
      with:
        path: |
          test/example/deps
          test/example/_build
        # Phoenix validates endpoint configuration against the compile-time value.
        # Partition cached _build output by the PORT supplied to this consumer.
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-example-dev-port${{ inputs.app-port }}-otp${{ steps.setup_beam.outputs.otp-version }}-elixir${{ steps.setup_beam.outputs.elixir-version }}-dev-${{ hashFiles('test/example/mix.lock', 'test/example/config/**', 'test/example/lib/**/*.ex', 'lib/**/*.ex', 'mix.exs') }}-v1
        restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-example-dev-port${{ inputs.app-port }}-otp${{ steps.setup_beam.outputs.otp-version }}-elixir${{ steps.setup_beam.outputs.elixir-version }}-dev-

    - name: Fetch and compile example
      shell: bash
      working-directory: test/example
      env:
        MIX_ENV: dev
        PORT: ${{ inputs.app-port }}
        PGDATABASE: ${{ inputs.database-name }}
        PGPORT: ${{ inputs.database-port }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        mix deps.get
        mix compile --warnings-as-errors

    - name: Create, migrate, and seed example database
      shell: bash
      working-directory: test/example
      env:
        MIX_ENV: dev
        PORT: ${{ inputs.app-port }}
        PGUSER: postgres
        PGPASSWORD: postgres
        PGHOST: localhost
        PGDATABASE: ${{ inputs.database-name }}
        PGPORT: ${{ inputs.database-port }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        mix ecto.create
        mix ecto.migrate
        mix run priv/repo/seeds.exs

    - name: Install Playwright dependencies
      shell: bash
      working-directory: test/example/priv/playwright
      run: npm ci

    - name: Cache Playwright browsers
      id: playwright_browsers_cache
      if: inputs.cache-browsers == 'true'
      uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
        key: ${{ inputs.browser-cache-key }}

    - name: Normalize browser cache result
      id: browser_cache_result
      shell: bash
      env:
        CACHE_ENABLED: ${{ inputs.cache-browsers }}
        CACHE_HIT: ${{ steps.playwright_browsers_cache.outputs.cache-hit }}
      run: |
        if [ "$CACHE_ENABLED" = "true" ] && [ "$CACHE_HIT" = "true" ]; then
          echo "hit=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        else
          echo "hit=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        fi

    - name: Install Playwright browsers
      shell: bash
      working-directory: test/example/priv/playwright
      env:
        BROWSERS: ${{ inputs.browsers }}
        CACHE_HIT: ${{ steps.browser_cache_result.outputs.hit }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        if [ "$CACHE_HIT" = "true" ]; then
          npx playwright install-deps $BROWSERS
        else
          npx playwright install --with-deps $BROWSERS
        fi

    - name: Boot example app
      shell: bash
      working-directory: test/example
      env:
        MIX_ENV: dev
        PORT: ${{ inputs.app-port }}
        PGUSER: postgres
        PGPASSWORD: postgres
        PGHOST: localhost
        PGDATABASE: ${{ inputs.database-name }}
        PGPORT: ${{ inputs.database-port }}
        PHX_SERVER: "true"
        SERVER_LOG: ${{ inputs.server-log }}
      run: mix phx.server > "$SERVER_LOG" 2>&1 &

    - name: Wait for app and warm routes
      shell: bash
      env:
        BASE_URL: ${{ inputs.base-url }}
        WARMUP_PATHS: ${{ inputs.warmup-paths }}
        SERVER_LOG: ${{ inputs.server-log }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        ready=false
        for i in $(seq 1 30); do
          if curl -sf "$BASE_URL/" > /dev/null; then
            echo "App responding after ${i}s"
            ready=true
            break
          fi
          sleep 1
        done
        if [ "$ready" != "true" ]; then
          echo "::error::example app did not become ready at $BASE_URL"
          cat "$SERVER_LOG" || true
          exit 1
        fi
        for path in $WARMUP_PATHS; do
          curl --fail --silent --output /dev/null "$BASE_URL$path" \
            && echo "warmed $path" \
            || echo "warmup miss $path (non-fatal)"
        done
